title: WB2A A1 heating takt baseline and same-window pump clamp evidence

same_window_static_runtime.note: Read-only permanent-VS1 snapshot after the user enabled heating, before the later DHW takeover.

established: E7=30, GWG75=50, A1 runtime request=36, final internal-pump setpoint=50 and physical internal-pump speed=50 were observed in the same heating window.
Across 1085 pre-DHW samples the pump chain stayed exactly 36 -> 50 -> 50 while the flame repeatedly cycled.
Two complete flame-off to next-flame-on intervals were essentially identical at about 247.7 s.
Normal burner cycling/takt lock therefore did not withdraw or alter the A1 pump request or the final internal-pump setpoint in this capture.
interpretation.leading_model: For ordinary direct A1 heating, the observed data are consistent with final_internal_setpoint = max(A1_runtime_request, GWG75), subject to other operating-mode overrides.
not_established: The data do not prove the exact firmware formula.
The approximately 247.7 s off interval is observed timing; no coding parameter is assigned to it here.
The later transition to A1=0/internal=100 belongs to DHW takeover and is not an A1-withdrawal/GWG76 event.

follow_up.planned: Controlled E7 30 -> 100 -> 30 heating-cycle comparison with radiators opened, guarded against DHW/flame-time writes.
